en: A black‑and‑white photograph showing two children sitting with their backs to the camera on a low stone wall beside a river or lake. Across the calm water a European town is visible, with trees along the banks and the skyline dominated by two church towers: one tall, slender neo‑Gothic spire in the center and a shorter baroque‑style tower with a dome and cross to its left. The church spire and surrounding buildings are reflected clearly in the still water. There is no visible printed text or caption on the image side.
